g.text: asks to do a railway line maintenance
asks for a scenario file with the stations
asks for a scenario file with the lines
asks if the maintenance should be of all tracks
finds a route that passes once and only once by all
railway lines and displays the stations where the route can start
shows all data and requests confirmation
displays a graphical visualization of the stations and lines
connecting them and displays operation success
does not find a route that passes once and only once
by all railway lines and displays a warning message
finds a route that passes once and only once by only electrified
railway lines and displays the stations where the route can start
shows all data and requests confirmation
displays a graphical visualization of the stations and lines
connecting them and displays operation success
does not find a route that passes once and only once
by only electrified railway lines and displays a warning message
